name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled static sites, including virtual hosts, document roots, TLS settings, security headers, rate limits, Fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and kernel network hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, service enablement, log directory ownership, and cleanup of replication-related configuration directives.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI tutorial application with Python, a virtual environment, Git checkout, PostgreSQL database and user setup, environment configuration, dependencies, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
